name: 01-seitliche-reiter
title: 01 / Seitliche Reiter
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE premium polished UX concept presentation board for existing German website LONG COVID NAVIGATOR (LCN). This is a radically redesigned NAVIGATION AND INTERACTION concept, NOT another long scroll homepage. Landscape board approximately 1800x1300, one dominant large front-on DESKTOP website screenshot occupying 80% of board, plus one clearly separated small alternate-state inset and concise German annotation at bottom. Precise clean sans-serif, fine borders, large readable German UI text, generous whitespace. Navy #17365d, vivid blue #0878e3, teal #00817d, white and pale blue #f7fafc. Elegant confident design, materially different compositions each concept. Brand tiny blue compass outline and LCN, retain site identity. Short landscape banner optional only max 100px tall. Main headline 'Was möchtest du tun?' or 'Dein nächster Schritt'. Existing functionality only, no articles, no 'Artikel lesen', no new global search, no medical advice wizard, no symptom diagnosis, no AI recommendation, no fake ratings, no new content. These are real catalog TOOLS.
EXISTING DESTINATIONS to expose through your navigation: 'Empfehlung' containing two concrete lists 'Therapien im Fokus' and 'Behandler im Fokus'; 'Hausärzte' containing existing location input, Germany pin map and adjacent results list; 'Suche' leading to existing 'Therapien suchen' and 'Behandler finden'; 'Ergänzen' leading to existing proposal forms 'Behandlung ergänzen' and 'Behandler ergänzen'; 'Über das Projekt' secondary.
DATA if showing recommendations: two actual catalog tables side by side, headers therapy panel 'Therapie | Behandler', provider panel 'Behandler | Ort | Therapien'. Ten therapy rows with counts: Low-Dose Naltrexon (LDN) 12, Pacing 21, Ivabradin 4, Erhöhte Salzaufnahme 3, Erhöhte Flüssigkeitszufuhr 3, Hyperbare Sauerstofftherapie (HBOT) 4, H.E.L.P.-Apherese 5, Therapeutischer Plasmaaustausch (TPE) 4, Immunadsorption 5, N-Acetylcystein (NAC) 3. Ten provider rows: Dr. Michael Stingl | Wien | 64; Prof. Dr. Carmen Scheibenbogen | Berlin | 3; Dr. Michael Kacik | Münster | 109; Dr. Beate Jaeger | Mülheim | 4; Dr. Maja Strasser | Solothurn | 172; Dr. Bettina Hohberger | Erlangen | 3; Dr. Valentina Puntmann | Frankfurt | 6; Prof. Dr. Uta Behrends | München | 4; Dr. Herbert Renz-Polster | Rottweil | 1; Dr. Kristina Schultheiß | Immenstadt | 32. Small note 'Redaktionelle Auswahl – kein Wirksamkeitsranking'. Buttons 'Top-Therapien ansehen', 'Top-Behandler ansehen'. Numbers are catalog relationships, NOT success rates.
DATA if showing Hausärzte: title 'Hausärztliche Versorgung', existing form label 'Dein Ausgangsort', field 'Adresse, PLZ oder Ort eingeben', button 'Anlaufstellen finden', real Germany map graphic with blue pins, result list 'Arke Dixon · Hamburg', 'Benjamin Seliger · Halle (Saale)', 'Görte Bertram · München', 'Dr. Adrian Knispel · Mölln', 'Dr. Andreas Grothusen · Hamburg'. Existing actions 'Hausärztliche Suche öffnen', 'Deine Hausarztpraxis fehlt?' / 'Praxis ergänzen'.
DATA if showing Suche: two clear direct links 'Therapien suchen' / 'Behandler finden' opening existing full catalog search pages. DATA if showing Ergänzen: two attractive choices 'Behandlung ergänzen', 'Behandler ergänzen'; subcopy 'Fehlt ein Eintrag? Schlage ihn für den Katalog vor.' These open EXISTING FORMS, do not invent fields or a new publishing workflow. No user accounts.
Only currently selected tool needs full display; other tools stay one click away through clearly labeled navigation. Show active states, chevrons and exactly how selection opens panel. Small footer 'Über das Projekt · Datenschutz · Impressum'. All text German. Do not show all homepage modules vertically. SPECIFIC COMPOSITION: FULL DESKTOP APP-LIKE HOMEPAGE, narrow white brand header top and a permanent 220px left sidebar with large vertical icon+text tabs 'Empfehlung' active teal, 'Hausärzte', 'Suche', 'Ergänzen', and small 'Über das Projekt' below. In right main area short welcome text then a large white rounded workspace showing BOTH real ten-row recommendation tables. Left rail has generous spacing, active tab tinted teal with blue slim left marker. Bottom/right alternate-state inset shows SAME LEFT RAIL with 'Ergänzen' active and right area TWO stunning horizontal large choice buttons 'Behandlung ergänzen', 'Behandler ergänzen' with plus/document/person icons. German caption 'Reiter wählen → Werkzeug erscheint rechts'. Distinctive confident dashboard composition, no oversized image hero.
